page.layout: One page of text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head centred at the top, page number at top right. Signature "Ff" at the foot. Notes: the three-line note "Discentis officium inter audiendum." beside the paragraph on "Officium discentis", and the short note "Scriptio." beside the paragraph "Scriptio est". Text blocks in reading order: first the paragraphs above, then the chapter heading "Cap. 15. De scriptione.", then the paragraphs of that chapter.

page.notes: The ornamental band between the chapter 14 text and the heading "Cap. 15." is a decorative border, not text, and is left out. The Greek word "ἀκροάσει" and the second half of "νευτα" (printed "νευτα" with a Greek ᾗ before "ἀξιοθέατα") are doubtful at this resolution. The Greek word "ἀξιομνημό-" is hyphenated at the line end as printed. The note letters and the underlined "Quid?" are read as printed; "Quid?" is set in italic. The first "Fuit" carries a large woodcut-style initial F. The margin note is set in small type across three lines and is split by the printed hyphens "in-ter" and "audien-dum". Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
